\section{Retarded function}
For a level of width $\Gamma>0$ the retarded function is
\begin{equation}
G(\omega) = \frac{1}{\omega-\epsilon+i\Gamma} .
\label{eq:gr}
\end{equation}
\section{Advanced function}
In this section $G$ denotes the advanced function instead,
\begin{equation}
G(\omega) = \frac{1}{\omega-\epsilon-i\Gamma} ,
\label{eq:ga}
\end{equation}
so that its inverse is
\begin{equation}
\frac{1}{G(\omega)} = \omega - \epsilon - i\Gamma .
\label{eq:inv}
\end{equation}
